verses.text: A message from the LORD: judgment is coming to Hadrach, and Damascus will feel its weight. The eyes of all people and all Israel’s tribes are on the LORD.
“Hamath will face it too, along with Tyre and Sidon, even though they’re so clever.
“Tyre built herself a fortress and piled up silver like dust, gold like street mud.
“Look, the Lord will take her city away. He’ll strike her power in the sea, and fire will consume her.
“Ashkelon will see and be afraid. Gaza will writhe in pain, and Ekron will lose hope. Gaza’s king will be gone, and Ashkelon will be deserted.
“Foreigners will settle in Ashdod, and I’ll cut down the Philistines’ pride.

“I’ll take the blood from their mouths and the disgusting food from between their teeth. Those who remain will belong to our God; they’ll become leaders in Judah, and Ekron will be like the Jebusites.
“I’ll camp around my house to guard it against armies, so no one can pass through or return. No oppressor will ever march through again, because I’ve seen what’s happening.”
Rejoice, daughter of Zion! Shout, daughter of Jerusalem! Look—your King is coming to you. He is righteous and brings salvation, humble and riding on a donkey, on a young donkey’s colt.

“I’ll take the chariots from Ephraim and the warhorses from Jerusalem. The battle bow will be broken. He will announce peace to the nations; his rule will reach from sea to sea, from the River to the ends of the earth.
“As for you, because of the blood of our covenant, I’ll release your prisoners from the waterless pit.
“Return to the stronghold, you prisoners who still have hope! Even today I promise to restore twice what you lost.
“I’ll bend Judah like a bow and load it with Ephraim. Zion, I’ll stir up your people against Greece; I’ll make you like a warrior’s sword.
“The LORD will appear above them. His arrow will flash like lightning. The Lord GOD will sound the trumpet and advance in the storms from the south.
“The LORD of Armies will protect them. They’ll strike down their enemies with slingstones. They’ll drink and shout like people filled with wine; they’ll be full like bowls at the altar’s corners.
“On that day the LORD their God will save them as the flock of his people. They’ll sparkle like jewels in a crown, lifted high over his land.
“How great his goodness is, how beautiful he is! Grain will make young men flourish, and new wine will make young women thrive.
